verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents Scheduling Links with 'smart meeting controls'. It also documents buffer time: travel time before and after events with a location, and decompression time after meetings. Those buffers protect the calendar around meetings, but they are general calendar features rather than documented booking-link settings. Missing for 10: evidence of minimum-notice settings, daily booking caps, date-range booking windows, explicit per-link before/after buffers, and independent corroboration.
